record.what_it_does: Work management and collaboration platform with sheets, projects, automation and reports.
record.auth_notes: 3-legged OAuth 2.0 for multi-user apps (requires registered app with client ID/secret, HTTPS redirect URLs, scopes like ADMIN_WEBHOOKS). Personal API access tokens (Bearer) generated in UI for single-user use.
record.access_notes: Docs state required plan for API access token: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management. Developer account (free registration) gives Developer Tools to register OAuth apps and a sandbox account. Whether public OAuth distribution needs review was not confirmed.
record.api_breadth_notes: Sheets, rows, columns, cells, attachments, comments, workspaces, folders, reports, sights/dashboards, users, groups, webhooks, search, etc. Regional hosts (US/EU/AU).
record.mcp_notes: Hosted at mcp.smartsheet.com (US), mcp.smartsheet.eu, mcp.smartsheet.au; GA March 2026; OAuth 2.0 or token. Also local package @smartsheet/smar-mcp.
record.blocker_notes: API/token access requires a paid plan (Business/Enterprise/Advanced Work Management); developer account/sandbox is available for testing but plan limits should be verified.

evidence.quote: Required plan: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
the Smartsheet implementation of OAuth 2.0 is a 3-legged process, which requires human intervention.

record.needs_human: Confirm sandbox availability/terms and whether OAuth apps need Smartsheet review before public distribution; the MCP and sandbox details came from search summaries, not fetched pages.
